verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents task tracking with overdue status, customizable notifications for recurring obligations like annual penetration testing, reminders for assigned personnel tasks, and owner attributes on policies. Together these approximate a workflow for non-automated evidence. However, nothing shows owners, due dates, and expiry tracking attached to every manual evidence artifact. Missing for 10: explicit manual-evidence upload workflow, per-artifact owner assignment, documented due dates, expiry/validity tracking on uploaded evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Customize notifications for required regular tasks throughout the year including quarterly user access reviews and annual penetration testing.
Customers can quickly see failing tests, overdue tasks, mentions, audit activity, vendor updates, and other items that require attention.
Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
add attributes like company name, policy owner, and date modified
